Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.platform

Class ZentrixCapabilities

java.lang.Object
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.platform.ZentrixCapabilities
public final class ZentrixCapabilities extends Object
Ids of the capabilities Zentrix reports itself through PlatformService.getCapability(java.lang.String).

Each one separates "this feature exists in the API" from "this server can do it now": a method that exists may still be restricted by the edition, missing a dependency or switched off.

Since:
1.8.0
